testCase.description: DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "round up(5.5) = 6". Normative example of the new single-parameter round up(n).
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "round down(5.5) = 5". Normative example of the new single-parameter round down(n).
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "round half up(5.5) = 6". Normative example of the new single-parameter round half up(n).
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "round half down (5.5) = 5". Normative example of the new single-parameter round half down(n).
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "round up(-5.5, 0) = -6"; the single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"). Derived: round up(-5.5) = -6 (away from zero).
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "round down (-5.5, 0) = -5"; the single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"). Derived: round down(-5.5) = -5 (toward zero).
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "round half up(-5.5, 0) = -6"; the single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"). Derived: round half up(-5.5) = -6 (tie away from zero).
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "round half down (-5.5, 0) = -5"; the single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"). Derived: round half down(-5.5) = -5 (tie toward zero).

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: round up(n) "Return n with given scale and rounding mode round up" (cf. "round up(1.121, 2) = 1.13"); single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"). Edge: non-tie fraction rounds away from zero to 2.

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: round down(n) "Return n with given scale and rounding mode round down" (cf. "round down (1.121, 2) = 1.12"); single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"). Edge: fraction just below 2 truncates toward zero to 1.

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: round half up(n) "rounding mode round half up" (cf. "round half up(1.121, 2) = 1.12"); single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"). Edge: non-tie below half rounds to nearest, 2.

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: round half down(n) (cf. "round half down (-1.126, 2) = -1.13", non-ties round to nearest); single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"). Edge: non-tie above half rounds to nearest, 3.

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: round up(n) returns n with scale 0 (single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0")). Edge: an integer is already at scale 0 and is returned unchanged.

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: rows "round up(n) / round up(n, scale)" etc. share one description; DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0". Edge: each single-parameter form equals the two-parameter form with scale 0.
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "If at least one of n or scale is null the result is null." round up(null) = null.
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "If at least one of n or scale is null the result is null." round down(null) = null.
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "If at least one of n or scale is null the result is null." round half up(null) = null.
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: "If at least one of n or scale is null the result is null." round half down(null) = null.

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: parameter domain of n is "number"; DMN 1.6 §10.3.4: "Whenever a parameter is outside its domain, the result of the built-in is null." (cf. §11.3: round up("5.5", 0) is null in FEEL). round up("5.5") = null.
DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: parameter domain of n is "number"; DMN 1.6 §10.3.4: "Whenever a parameter is outside its domain, the result of the built-in is null." round half down(true) = null.

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: round down(n) truncates toward zero (single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0")); §10.3.2.3.1: "There is no distinction between -0 and 0." Edge: round down(-0.5) = 0.

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: round half up(n) (single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"); cf. "round half up(5.5) = 6", ties away from zero). Edge: round half up(0.5) = 1.

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: round half down(n) (single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"); cf. "round half down (5.5) = 5", ties toward zero). Edge: round half down(0.5) = 0.

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: round up(n) "Return n with given scale and rounding mode round up"; single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"; cf. "round up(5.5) = 6"). Edge: the official TCK 1141 case round up(1234.12) was commented out "pending RTF"; DMN16-93 resolved it, so round up(1234.12) = 1235.

DMN 1.6 §10.3.4.5 Table 77: round half up(n) (single-parameter form uses scale 0 (DMN16-93: "It assumes a scale of 0"); cf. "round half up(-5.5, 0) = -6", negative ties away from zero). Edge: round half up(-0.5) = -1.
